title: Halloween sausage dog walk at Salford Quays
author: Sophie_C90
text: Halloween sausage dog walk at Salford Quays 🎃👻
blurb: Happy Halloween from a little black-and-tan doxie trotting along in a full pumpkin costume, leaf hat and all. Their human snapped this mid-strut on a sunny Halloween sausage dog walk at Salford Quays.
